description: issue #844: the EXECUTE-mode twin of geometry/check/overlay-names-are-callable's parenthesized form. `(grid)`/`(axes)`/`(measure)` supply exactly zero inputs through the parenthesized call form, so each dispatches identically to its bare form and emits one `overlay` event — the same payloads geometry/overlays/overlays-survive-clean pins for the bare form from the same home turtle state (`measure` therefore carries `position:[0,0]`/`heading:0`; geometry/overlays/measure-basic pins a moved turtle instead, so its payload differs by design). This proves ParenCall dispatch, not just Call, reaches the overlay primitives, and that a zero-argument parenthesized call is accepted at runtime exactly as the checker accepts it.
